refund chahiye
order fail hua
abhi batao
confirm kijiye
matlab kya
bank ka naam kya hai
kab hua transaction

items.context: can you please confirm the transaction amount
items.text: yes sahi hai

items.context: is this the name on the account where money was debited
items.text: nahi ubaid hai

items.context: do you want us to initiate the refund process now
items.text: theek hai samajh gaya
mera naam rohini gupta hai aur paise 5000 kat gaye the lekin transfer nahi hua
mujhe refund chahiye kyunki mera upi transaction fail ho gaya tha par paise account se nikal gaye
saheb mera account number 12345678 se paise kat gaye lekin payment receiver ko nahi mila
maine last saturday ko online payment kiya tha par amount abhi tak wapas nahi aaya hai
maine flipkart par order diya tha lekin payment fail hone ke baad bhi paisa kat gaya tha
mujhe confirmation chahiye ki mera paise kab refund honge kyunki transfer nahi hua tha
ajay kumar yahan ghaziabad se bol raha hu mera 2000 rupaye ka payment fail hua hai

items.context: please tell me the date and time of the failed transaction
items.text: transcation kab hua tha kya aapko yaad hai

items.context: from which account was the payment debited please provide the number
items.text: paise kahan se kat gaye the matlab account number batao

items.context: would you like us to help with refund or anything else
items.text: apko refund chahiye ya fir kuch aur madad

items.context: can you share the name of the beneficiary who was supposed to receive the money
items.text: kya receiver ka name batayenge jinhone payment lena tha

items.context: do you have the transaction reference number handy
items.text: transaction ka reference number mere paas hai agar chahiye to
mera naam shweta hain aur main delhi ki rehne wali hun mera upi transaction last week mein fail ho gaya tha lekin paise account se kat gaye the
main anil hoon aur mera account number 9988776655 se 3000 rupaye transfer karne ki koshish ki thi par paisa receiver ke account mein nahi gaya hai
namaste mera naam piyush singh hai aur main noida mein rehta hun maine 12 march ko ek payment kiya tha jo fail ho gaya par paise kat gaye the

items.context: mujhe pata karna hai ki refund process shuru karne ke liye transaction date aur amount chaiye
items.text: aapka transaction kab hua tha aur kitni rashi thi

items.context: kya aap mujhe apne bank account ki details de sakte hain taaki aapki madad kar paun
items.text: apka bank account ka naam aur address denge taaki verification ho sake

items.context: kya main janna sakta hun ki jis upi id se transaction hua tha wo kya thi
items.text: kya aap mujhe batayenge ki upi id kya thi jisse paise transfer karne ki koshish ki thi

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: banking
Intent: failed_upi_refund - a UPI or online payment failed but money was debited; wants a refund
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
